title: Automation service catalogue
content: Focused builds can cover Python reporting, spreadsheet cleanup, API integrations, internal dashboards, and source-aware support assistants. Scope is agreed around one clear workflow and handover package.

title: Pricing and discovery policy
content: Pricing depends on the workflow, data sources, integrations, and delivery risk. A fixed quote follows a short discovery step using sample inputs and an agreed definition of done.

title: Delivery and handover policy
content: A focused engagement starts with sample data and acceptance criteria, then moves through a working preview, validation, deployment, and documented handover. Urgent timelines are confirmed only after reviewing the workflow.

title: Document automation capabilities
content: Document workflows can extract approved fields, summarize files, apply validation rules, and export structured CSV or JSON. Sensitive files should use client-approved storage, access controls, and retention rules.
